cells.gaps: No count or share of primary schools entering data is published; the minister's letter of 16 February 2026 says only that several schools update the CEP class alone. No fact shows primary schools entering attendance or results: the kept facts disagree, the newest (BEN-005, BEN-002) giving enrolment and the routine entry of BEN-011 being secondary only, with BEN-015 of 2020 not saying how often or at which level results are entered. Finance is not stated, and the plan held (BEN-017) ended in 2021 and is not current. BEN-003 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: Educmaster is past any pilot and primary schools themselves enter enrolments and class lists on it, a learner register filled at the school, which is stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary schools entering attendance or results during the year on a published share or count, and neither the routine entry nor the figure is held for primary.
